title: 2025 AMC 10A Problem 18
statement:
The harmonic mean of a collection of numbers is the reciprocal of the arithmetic mean of the reciprocals of the numbers in the collection. For example, the harmonic mean of \(4,\) \(4,\) and \(5\) is

\[\frac{1}{\frac{1}{3}\left(\frac{1}{4} + \frac{1}{4} + \frac{1}{5}\right)} = \frac{30}{7}.\]

What is the harmonic mean of all the real roots of the \(4050\)th degree polynomial

\[ \begin{gathered} \prod_{k=1}^{2025}(kx^2 - 4x - 3) \\ {}= (x^2 - 4x - 3) \\ \quad {}\cdot (2x^2 - 4x - 3) \\ \quad {}\cdot (3x^2 - 4x - 3)\cdots \\ \quad {}\cdot (2025x^2 - 4x - 3)? \end{gathered} \]

solutions.text: Look at one factor \(kx^2 - 4x - 3.\) Its discriminant \(16 + 12k\) is positive, so it has two distinct real roots. Roots from different factors are also distinct: a common root \(x\) for indices \(k_1\) and \(k_2\) would satisfy \((k_1-k_2)x^2=0,\) but \(x\ne0.\) By Vieta, the two reciprocals from one factor sum to \(\frac{x_1 + x_2}{x_1 x_2} = \frac{\frac{4}{k}}{-\frac{3}{k}} = -\tfrac{4}{3}.\) Summing over all \(2025\) factors, the reciprocals total \(2025 \cdot \left(-\tfrac{4}{3}\right) = -2700.\) There are \(4050\) real roots in all, so the harmonic mean is \(\frac{4050}{-2700} = -\tfrac{3}{2}.\) Therefore, the answer is B.
hints: For each factor \(kx^2 - 4x - 3,\) Vieta gives root sum \(\tfrac{4}{k}\) and product \(-\tfrac{3}{k},\) so the reciprocal-sum is their quotient
The harmonic mean is the number of roots divided by the total sum of reciprocals
